terms: The OANC publisher describes this data as unrestricted for use and redistribution, including commercial development. Preserve this provenance notice with derived resources.
license: Unrestricted use and redistribution, including commercial development, per the publisher's current terms
inputFormat: Official OANC GrAF ZIP; read primary UTF-8 text directly from ZIP without extracting its 7.4 GB expanded contents.
purpose: Written-American-English context counts for local correction ranking only. No grammar-error labels, POS gold labels, or learner-essay claims are derived from this corpus.
exclusions: The spoken collection is excluded because Linguorithm's product scope is written text.
Sentence boundaries are approximated from terminal punctuation for n-gram context; these counts are not syntax annotations.
